en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Hammad Bin Usman, from Al Haris Bin Al Mugheira Al Nasry,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [35:28] but rather the ones from His servants who fear Allah, are the scholars.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It Means by the ‘scholars’, the one whose deeds ratify his words, and the one whose deed does not ratify his words, so he is not with the knowledge’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus from Hammad ibn ‘Uthman from al-Harith ibn Mughirah al-Nasri from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.)
about the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most gracious. “Only God’s knowledgeable servants fear Him . ..”, [35:28]
that scholars are those whose deeds would testify to the truthfulness of their words, otherwise, they are not scholars.’”
